title: Cold Weather and Wet Conditions
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on cold weather and wet-condition use, with clear complaints about a frozen fuel filler flap and awkward gap adjustment in the wet, while most other mentions only note weather-related context or range comments without enough detail to confirm sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the fuel filler flap freezing shut in cold weather and difficulty adjusting following distance in wet conditions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention wet weather, cold temperatures, seat wetness, and cold-weather range impacts, but the short fragments do not provide enough context to confirm a clear sentiment in this sample.

limitations: This cluster mixes several loosely related subjects, including cold-weather range, wet-weather driving, a frozen fuel filler flap, and seat wetness, rather than one single coherent issue.
Most fragments are very short and lack enough context to determine whether the mention is praise, complaint, or simple description.
The sampled examples are few and stratified, so they should not be treated as representative of all G60 feedback on weather-related topics.
